description: Get the most recent event involving a specific contact or group JID. IMPORTANT: this returns the newest event of ANY type - including call logs, media, and system notifications, which have an empty "body" - NOT necessarily the last text message. To read what was actually said, use list_messages instead.

jid.description: The JID of the contact or group (e.g., 123456789@c.us or 123456789-12345678@g.us)

name: get_last_interaction
